values.note: Campspot lists June 2027 at $29 for a Standard Site and $35 for a Premium (waterfront) site, Tuesday and Saturday alike, plus the park's $5 booking fee once per stay and a 3% processing fee. The $26 Basic Site is sold only to pop-ups, tents, truck campers and vans, not motorhomes. Osceola County's 2026 rate sheet (approved May 5, 2026): $27 standard, $33 premium waterfront, $24 basic, $23 primitive, one rate for everyone; weekly and monthly rates too. Every vehicle needs a county parking permit, $8 a day or $30 a year. Dumping costs $15.

entrance.name: Osceola County Parks vehicle permit ($30 annual sticker)

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/rose-lake-park (Campspot pricing per site type for 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12: Standard Site 26715/26716 base $29.00, Premium Site 26713 $35.00, Basic Site 26712 $26.00 with equipment 'Pop-Up, Tent, Truck Camper, Van'; Booking Fee $5.00, Processing Fee 3%; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl) + the county's 2026 rate sheet ('Daily - Standard 27.00', 'Daily - Premium Waterfront 33.00', 'Daily - Rose Lake Basic Sites 24.00', 'Daily pass $8.00 per day', 'Dump Station Fee 15.00'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 136 RV sites on Campspot: 95 Standard (30/50 amp, water, to 38-40 ft, some pull-through), 14 Premium waterfront (to 38 ft) and 27 Basic (20 amp, water, to 30 ft, vans and pop-ups only); plus 12 primitive tent sites. Every camper must back in.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/rose-lake-park (site types: Standard Site 93 sites len 40 + 2 sites len 38, Premium Site 14 len 38, Basic Site 27 len 30, Primitive Tent Site 12; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl) + county rules ('All campers must be backed into the campsite with hitch facing the road'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: County 2026 rate sheet ('Dump Station Fee 15.00 per dump for scheduled'), read 2026-10-25. The derived camp_store (note prose) is stated by neither the county nor Campspot; cleared to unknown.

values.note: Booked on the county's Campspot page, up to 6 months ahead. Premium sites take 3 nights on weekends and holidays and allow 15 nights a season; other sites a month at most. Day, week, month and season camping.

booking.source: https://www.osceola-county.org/residents/county_departments/parks/index.php ('Reservations will be taken up to 6 months in advance', link www.campspot.com/book/rose-lake-park) + Campspot ('Cannot book more than 181 days in advance') + the 2026 rate sheet ('3-night minimum stay on premium sites weekends & holidays', '15-night Maximum stay on Premium sites per season', '1-month Maximum stay on Non-Premium sites'), read 2026-10-25

summary: County parks page, its 2026 rate sheet and the park's Campspot engine: fees 26-35 -> 29-35 (the $26 Basic Site is sold to pop-ups/tents/truck campers/vans only, so the cheapest motorhome type is the $29 Standard Site); confirmed 50 A / water, season May 1 - Sept 26, dump; added 136 RV sites to 40 ft with pull-throughs, Campspot booking 181 days ahead with the premium-site minimum and stay caps; cleared the derived camp_store. Note unchanged (holds no field facts). The county has no Rose Lake page of its own; the parks page stays.
